description: Find products/services (артикули) with prices and available stock (наличност). Give sku for an exact match, or query/name to match the name. Use it before invoicing to reuse the correct item name, sku and price.

query.description: Text to match in the item name

response_format.description: "concise" (default) returns key fields; "detailed" adds lines and the raw nula.bg record

sku.description: Exact SKU (Арт. номер), model or barcode

name: nula_search_items
title: Search items and stock
